# EkeBoss Restaurant — Project Requirements

## In scope

1. **Mobile booking experience** — The reservation/booking page must work well on mobile devices (375px+). Current experience has usability issues.
2. **Performance improvement** — Target Lighthouse performance score of 70+ on mobile.
3. **SEO foundations** — Ensure meta descriptions, proper heading hierarchy, and Google My Business integration.

## Out of scope

- Backend payment processing
- Custom booking engine development (use existing plugin)
- Social media management

## Acceptance criteria (initial)

- All key booking actions visible without horizontal scrolling on 375px viewport
- Booking form submits successfully on mobile
- Page load time under 3 seconds on average connection
- No broken links on main navigation

## Technical constraints

- WordPress with shared cPanel hosting
- Cannot change hosting provider in Phase 1
- Must preserve existing content and SEO rankings
- No access to production server directly — changes via WordPress admin or SFTP only
